instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Helix is a key regional wholesale distributor specializing in plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies, maintaining robust relationships with over 500 independent contractors. The company manages a large central distribution hub and operates a fleet of delivery vehicles across the region to serve local hardware retailers and specialized contractors.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats through operational excellence and exclusive partnerships that would be costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.
answers.additionalContext: We are in the final stages of being acquired by a larger international group. The deal is expected to close in 3 months. The acquiring company has a strong reputation for technology-driven operations, and we anticipate significant investment in modernizing our systems post-acquisition.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.

opportunities.title: Implement Warehouse Management System (WMS) Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Migrating the current warehouse management system to a more efficient solution will reduce operational bottlenecks and improve inventory accuracy, directly addressing process friction.

first_actions: Conduct a vendor RFP focused solely on integration ease and cost per user.
Pilot the proposed WMS functionality in one department (e.g., electrical supplies) over 3 months.
resources_needed: Internal IT staff time for migration/training
External consulting support for initial setup
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in inventory discrepancy rate by 15% within 6 months.

opportunities.title: Enhanced Customer Loyalty Tiering Program
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing NPS data to create a targeted loyalty program for the top 10% of contractor customers will build strong retention moats that are difficult for competitors to replicate.

first_actions: Analyze current customer transaction history and frequency metrics.
Design three tiered reward levels based on purchasing volume and service responsiveness.
resources_needed: Minimal system update to CRM functionality
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in repeat customer purchases from the top tier by 10% within 9 months.
milestones: Program launch and marketing campaign start (Month 4)

opportunities.title: Localized Predictive Maintenance Dashboard
opportunities.rationale: Developing a simple, localized predictive analytics dashboard for key distributor clients could offer exclusive service improvements that provide a high-value defense against new market entrants.

first_actions: Identify the top 20 strategic accounts willing to participate in a pilot program.
Develop a simple data visualization prototype using existing operational data.
resources_needed: Contracting a small, specialized data science consultant ($8k)
Internal data scientist time allocation (40% of sprint capacity)
execution_plan.success_metric: Client adoption rate of the predictive dashboard among pilot accounts exceeding 50%.
milestones: Pilot project definition and scope lock (Month 3)
Full operational integration and scaling plan (Month 9)

next_steps.action: Launch the vendor RFP for WMS upgrades to identify immediate operational process improvements.
Develop a detailed customer segmentation strategy based on NPS data to define the Loyalty Program structure.
Identify and secure internal 'talent' development roadmap for key technical skills required by the potential acquirer.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on owner-alone decision-making, leading to potential bottlenecks in cross-functional alignment.
Limited digital maturity and partial innovation process are hindering scalable, rapid experimentation with high-risk bets.
Resource constraints (low budget allocation) limit the ability to pursue ambitious radical innovations without external funding or acquisition.
